question: Compare \(-2/3\) and \(-3/4\). (Choose the correct conclusion.)
solution: When comparing two negative numbers, the one with the greater absolute value is smaller. \(2/3=8/12\) is less than \(3/4=9/12\), so \(-2/3>-3/4\).
